title: Electric Bikes in Starved Rock Country
seo_title: Aventon Electric Bikes for Sale in Ottawa, IL
seo_description: Shop Aventon electric bikes at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL, steps from the I&M Canal Trail in Starved Rock Country. Test rides, parts and service.
body_html:
Explore Starved Rock Country under electric power. Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL carries Aventon electric bikes, right along the I&M Canal Trail. Stop in for a test ride and we will help you find the right fit, whether you want a commuter, a trail bike or a relaxed recreational ride.

Shop all eBikes · eBike parts & accessories · Rent an eBike

Aventon eBikes at Quest

Many models are in stock; others are available by special order. Call 815.433.2200 to check availability, colors and sizes.

Trail and mountain

  • Aventon Current EXP – $5,999. Full-suspension eMTB with a carbon front triangle, Ultro X mid-drive motor, RockShox Lyrik fork and Super Deluxe shock, SRAM Maven brakes and S1000 wireless transmission. Midnight Black or Glacier Mint.
  • Aventon Current ADV – $3,999. Full-suspension eMTB with Ultro X mid-drive motor, RockShox Psylo Gold fork, Deluxe Select+ shock, SRAM DB8 brakes and Eagle 70 transmission. Blue Onyx or Camouflage.
  • Aventon Ramblas ADV – $2,899. Hardtail eMTB with A100 mid-drive motor (100 Nm torque), RockShox Psylo coil fork, SRAM DB6 4-piston brakes, SRAM NX 12-speed, 150 mm dropper post and a 90-mile range.
  • Aventon Aventure 3 – $1,999 (+ $160 assembly & tuning). Fat tire ebike in step-over and step-through, with a 750W hub motor, 4" puncture-resistant tires, suspension fork and seatpost, rack, fenders and kickstand included.
  • Aventon Aventure M – $2,899. Mid-drive fat tire ebike with A100 motor (100 Nm torque), 26"x4" tires, suspension fork and seatpost, E-Shifter, Autoshift, rack, fenders and kickstand.

Commuter and recreation

  • Aventon Level 4 ADV – $2,799. Mid-drive commuter with Ultro S motor, 100 Nm torque, up to 110-mile range and Shimano CUES 10-speed with E-Shifter and Autoshift. Step-over and step-through, by special order.
  • Aventon Level 4 REC – $1,999 (+ $160 assembly & tuning). Step-over and step-through, 750W hub motor, up to 75-mile range, regenerative braking, 4G/GPS, rack and fenders included.
  • Aventon Level 3 and Aventon Pace 4 – also available in the store; see the product pages for sizes and colors.

Cargo

  • Aventon Abound LR – $1,999. Long-tail cargo ebike with 750W hub motor, 440 lb capacity, throttle, integrated turn signals, 4G/GPS, rack, fenders and frame bag. By special order.
  • Aventon Abound SR – $1,899. Compact cargo ebike with 750W motor, 4G/GPS smart security, suspension fork and seatpost and a 440 lb payload.

Prices and availability change, so please confirm with us before you visit. Assembly & tuning is $160 on bikes that list it above.

Parts and accessories

Lights, pedals, racks, bags, phone holders, pumps and more for Aventon bikes. Browse eBike parts & accessories or call us if you cannot find what you need.

Rent, finance and register

  • eBike rentals are available from April 15 to late October at Heritage Harbor Ottawa.
  • Financing options are available for your eBike.
  • Learn where you can ride with our Illinois eBike regulations guide, the I&M Canal Trail guide and the eBike Charging Network.
  • Bought an Aventon? Register your bike for warranty coverage.

Visit us

Quest Watersports, 1851 Old Chicago Rd, Ottawa, IL 61350. Sales hours Tuesday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. See hours and directions or call 815.433.2200.
